svg.text: Fault or Attack: topology with upgrades
Grey = in the project today · green = added · dashed amber = planned upgrade (number = rank, re-ranked against API 2350 and Brunei's rules)

g.text: Outside and office IT · Purdue levels 4–5 · SL1
closes the inlet on its own

svg.text: Known weakness (see the topology report) · SL1–SL4 = example IEC 62443 security levels
The detector only advises the operator. It has no line to the overfill trip, which acts on its own (Brunei AI Security Policy Guidelines 9.2.2).
Rules: API 2350 5th ed.; Cybersecurity Act Cap. 272 s16; CSB Code of Practice for CII v2.0 (2026) cl. 6.1, 6.2, 7.1, 10.2–10.4.
